title: val_to_str default string in packet scope kept by an AT_STRINGZ address and printed after the scope ended
live_proof: absent at the 4.6.8 pin by inspection: wmem_packet_scope() no longer exists there (epan/wmem_scopes.c holds only the file and epan scopes), and packet-mdb.c allocates the string with val_to_str_wmem(pinfo->pool, ...). The pre-fix shape is quoted from 99da8c2cdc^ at packet-mdb.c:257 (the allocation) and :263/:267 (the stores).
object: the formatted default string of val_to_str, 55 bytes in the packet scope of release-4.4
lifetime_ender: wmem_leave_packet_scope at the end of epan_dissect_run_with_taps (epan.c:668 at the fix's parent), before the packet is printed
shape: packet-scope object held by a column or address past the scope's end
fidelity: model-consumer, real allocator; the seam's packet pool stands in for the separate wmem_packet_scope() pool of release-4.4, which is the same allocator type with the same reset
distinguishing: the holder is an address (set_address keeps the pointer), not a column set directly; no allocation intervenes before the read, so the unprotected arm returns the old bytes

native-detect.oracle: MEASURED 2026-10-09, results/2026-10-09-native-asan/: **NO ASan REPORT** on the buggy arm, which printed VERDICT DEFECT-REPRODUCED, so the defective access ran and ASan did not see it. The fixed arm exits 0 with VERDICT FIXED and no report. Built with the port's own allocator library under the same sanitizer (cc (Ubuntu 13.3.0-6ubuntu2~24.04.1) 13.3.0; -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -g -O0; wmem and the port built with the same flags). Positive controls in the same run: `asan-control past 402653184` -> heap-buffer-overflow; `asan-control uaf 402653184` -> heap-use-after-free -- so ASan reports on a heap block the size of this corpus's arena, and the silence is the arena: one malloc'd block, carved and recycled without free(). Predicted before the run (b64cd18b85d0); the arm was previously 'not written'.

cheribsd-revocation.target: stock CheriBSD purecap with libc revocation on
cheribsd-revocation.oracle: MEASURED 2026-10-10, results/2026-10-10-cheribsd-libc/: **NOT CAUGHT** on stock wmem with the system allocator as CheriBSD's libc (WM_LIBC_SYSTEM, WM_CHUNKS=OFF), revocation on: the buggy arm's reoccupation assertion held -- the stale chunk was REISSUED inside the block wmem kept, so libc's quarantine never saw it (missed, reused); fixed arm VERDICT FIXED. In the same boot control 90 (a jumbo g_free'd by the reset) was HELD by the quarantine and the revocation control faulted at its labelled load. The 2026-10-07 reading of this arm ran the hosted bump arena with the chunk port compiled in, where nothing reached free().
cheribsd-revocation.control: in the same boot (results/2026-10-10-cheribsd-libc/, provenance.tsv): the revocation control faulted at its labelled load (exit 162), the bounds control exited 162, and wmem's own control 90 -- a jumbo the reset hands to g_free, the one wmem path that does reach free() -- was HELD by libc's quarantine. So revocation was live and wmem traffic that reaches free() is seen; the completion here is a measured miss, not an absent integration. (The PoisonCap mode-1 13/13 this field used to cite is results/20260921-cheribsd/, a different bundle.)

native-fix-differential.oracle: MEASURED 2026-10-09, results/2026-10-09-native-differential/: the buggy sequence reaches storage outside its object (VERDICT DEFECT-REPRODUCED, exit 0) and the fixed sequence -- this case's upstream fix, modelled in case.c under wm_fixed -- does not (VERDICT FIXED, exit 0). Hosted build, upstream wmem allocator (WM_CHUNKS=OFF), `program 0 N buggy|fixed` (runners/run-native.sh). The arm did not exist before 2026-10-09: the cases had no fixed sequence.

sublet-malloc.target: Capstone domain, wmem AS RELEASED (WM_VARIANT=reference: none of the port's patches) on Sublet regions, mode 1: every g_malloc a region, every g_free a revoke -- Sublet only as the system allocator
sublet-malloc.oracle: complete: wmem as released keeps the stale object's block -- wm_next_packet is wmem_free_all on the BLOCK_FAST packet pool, which frees every block but the first and reinitialises that one (wmem_block_fast_free_all), and the object is far smaller than a block, so it sits in the kept first block; nothing reaches g_free, so the Sublet system allocator revokes nothing. MEASURED 2026-10-09, results/2026-10-09-sublet-malloc/: the sequence COMPLETES, NOT CAUGHT (image 7cecc6645aaced8b); the positive control 90 faulted in mode 1 and completed in mode 0 of the same build options.
